name: TPSR (Transformer-based Planning for Symbolic Regression)
one_liner: Wraps Monte Carlo Tree Search and BFGS numerical constant optimization around a pre-trained symbolic regression transformer.

loop.proposes: A pre-trained symbolic regression transformer (E2E / NeSymReS) provides prior probabilities over next mathematical operators in a prefix expression tree.
loop.judged_by: Once a complete equation skeleton is reached, BFGS optimizes its continuous constants and computes complexity-regularized NMSE fit on the dataset.
loop.steers: UCB tree search backpropagates the exact numerical fit reward to steer subsequent expression-tree expansions.

headline_result: Significantly improved symbolic equation recovery and extrapolation R^2 on SRBench and Feynman physics datasets over beam search or sampling.
caveat: Running BFGS constant optimization at leaf rollouts adds numerical overhead compared to single-pass forward decoding.
beyond_harness_note: Monte Carlo Tree Search and BFGS numerical optimization control decoding over a pre-trained symbolic transformer.
algorithmic_authority: Monte Carlo Tree Search and BFGS numerical optimizer

sources.title: Transformer-based Planning for Symbolic Regression (NeurIPS 2023 / arXiv:2303.06833)

verification.notes: Checked against Shojaee et al., NeurIPS 2023.
